base=evidence/quality/repair-window-17-20260923
orch="$base/orchestration"
manifest=.ai/task/repair-w17-20260923/PACK-MANIFEST.json
checked=0
while IFS=$'\t' read -r src rel expected_sha expected_bytes; do
  dst="$orch/$rel"
  cmp -s "$src" "$dst"

  actual_bytes=$(wc -c < "$dst")
  test "$actual_sha" = "$expected_sha"
  test "$actual_bytes" -eq "$expected_bytes"
  checked=$((checked + 1))
done < <(jq -r '.files[] | [.source,.relative_destination,.sha256,(.bytes|tostring)] | @tsv' "$manifest")
printf 'manifest_snapshot=%s_files_OK\n' "$checked"

  cmp -s "$candidate/$rel" "$rel"

done < <(find "$candidate" -type f -printf '%P\n' | sort)

cmp -s .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window17-20260923-migration.json evidence/production-review-v2-lite/migrations/5168dcc75a66cf6b89dc5c5ee1f0753064d427cc9461ad4a7ca1680c0fb084ec.json

done
